firm_data.firm_description: Notaro, Michalos & Zaccaria P.C. is a full service intellectual property law firm that provides its clients with a wide range of domestic and foreign intellectual property legal services and counseling. They have decades of experience handling a wide variety of intellectual property matters, technologies, business transactions, and litigation.
notable_facts: Provides services ranging from day-to-day consumer products to complex mechanical and electronic devices and biotech inventions
Has an international network of attorneys and agents.

email.subject: AI for Notaro, Michalos & Zaccaria, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi John,

With decades of experience across patent, trademark, and IP litigation, Notaro, Michalos & Zaccaria handles the complexity that demands precision. I imagine managing that volume with an 8-person team means every efficiency gain matters.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
